title: Does Steering Vector Effectiveness Decay With Depth as Chaos Theory Predicts?
original_idea: On GPT-2 Medium, inject a steering vector at each layer 0-23. Measure cosine similarity between steered and original residual stream at subsequent layers and effect on output token probabilities. Test for exponential decay consistent with chaotic amplification.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Directly tests whether linear steering methods have fundamental depth limits. Negative result would invalidate a major proposed safety intervention. Extremely high impact.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: TransformerLens makes layer-level injection straightforward. Cosine similarity and probability measurement are simple. GPT-2 Medium fits medium compute. Curve fitting is standard.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Very tight: one model, one steering vector, 24 injection points, two metrics, one hypothesis (exponential decay). Clear deliverable is a decay curve.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
